title: Chart of the Polaris Expedition, C. F. Hall commanding
creator: U.S. Navy Hydrographic Office
description: The official chart of the North Polar Expedition, laying down three separate tracks in different lines: the outward track of the Polaris up Smith Sound to Thank God Harbor, her return, and the drift of the ice-floe party that was carried 1,800 miles south to the Labrador Sea, with the boat party's course.

title: Coastal view from the Polaris, plate at scan leaf 67
creator: after sketches made on the expedition
description: A tinted plate of the coast and ice from the official narrative of the Polaris expedition.

title: Ship and ice, plate at scan leaf 71
creator: after sketches made on the expedition
description: A tinted plate of the ship among the floes on the passage up Smith Sound.

title: Ice cliffs, plate at scan leaf 75
creator: after sketches made on the expedition
description: A tinted plate of high ice and rock on the Greenland shore of the Kane Basin.

title: The winter quarters, plate at scan leaf 79
creator: after sketches made on the expedition
description: A tinted plate showing the shore establishment and figures at the winter quarters, with the ship housed over.
